recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat FHIR-6125 as historically applied and now intentionally refined by FHIR-20385, FHIR-31406, and FHIR-20500; do not add redundant or older absolute no-removal wording to the current profiling page.
issue_request: FHIR-6125 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It asked profiling guidance to make explicit that differentials cannot remove definitions, usage notes, rationale, or mappings, and that direct snapshots SHALL NOT remove definitions but MAY omit usage notes, rationale, and mappings only as a presentation choice that does not make inherited guidance untrue.
initial_application: SVN revision 5529, represented in git by ad7501455ceb4065e483002477c5ec314f64c615, applied the issue to source/profiling.html by adding comments/usage notes and mappings to profiling statements, adding a note that mappings and constraints could not be removed but could be omitted for clarity, and adding snapshot-tool wording about not suppressing mappings or constraints.
additional_context: Later final FHIR-I decisions intentionally refined the 2015 rule. FHIR-20385 allows removal of inherited descriptive ElementDefinition content, including mappings, when constraints make it invalid or irrelevant; FHIR-31406 defines ElementDefinition-suppress for selected descriptive properties such as comment, requirements, and mapping; and FHIR-20500 defines ElementDefinition.constraint.suppress for non-error constraint messages. These decisions are already represented on the combined branch and explain why the literal 2015 no-removal wording should not be restored.
reconciliation: No source was changed. Latest combined-branch source/profiling.html already says inherited meaning cannot be invalidated, keeps definition non-removable, requires ElementDefinition-suppress for bounded removal of listed descriptive properties, retains inherited constraints in snapshots, and documents eligible constraint-message suppression.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 decision allowing removal of inherited descriptive ElementDefinition content, including mappings, when constraints make it invalid or irrelevant; already represented on the combined branch.
Published R5 decision defining ElementDefinition-suppress for selected descriptive properties such as comment, requirements, and mapping; already represented on the combined branch.
Published R5 decision defining ElementDefinition.constraint.suppress for non-error constraint messages while retaining inherited constraints; already represented on the combined branch.
